Foundation & platform

Tools should make room for people.

I want technology to support care without taking over judgment. Clear permission, understandable behaviour and the possibility of repair matter to the things I choose to build.

ExecutionFoundation

Temple

Accountable execution. Explicit rules, checked changes and a history you can inspect.

I want the tools around us to stay within the authority people gave them.
